en-US.title: LightCycleTastic
en-US.subtitle: Light Cycle Duels. No Ads.
en-US.promoText: Play a friend face to face on one phone, or take on the CPU from Drone to Mainframe. Six powerups and five arenas when you want more chaos.
en-US.description:
A fast arcade duel for two players on one phone, or one player against the CPU. Every rider leaves a solid trail, and the last cycle still riding wins. No ads, no accounts.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Swipe to steer. Walls and every trail are deadly, your own included
• Two players sit face to face, each steering in their own half of the screen
• Or play the CPU at three difficulties: Drone, Bot, and Mainframe

MIX IT UP
• Five arenas: Open, Pillars, Gauntlet, Portals, and Underpass
• Six optional powerups: Overdrive, Stasis, Shield, Prune, Hack, and Overclock
• Three grid sizes, three speeds, a shorter trail option, and Wrap Edges

KEEP SCORE
• Player profiles, each with its own name and color
• Stats for every mode, color, and player
• 30 achievements in bronze, silver, and gold

ALWAYS READY
• A match pauses when you leave the app
• Light and dark mode, on iPhone and iPad
• Plays offline

If you play other Tastic games, your player profiles come with you on the same device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/LightCycles
